descriptions.text: Big Top Ticket. Lucky you! This ticket admits one adult into the Grimaldi's Traveling Circus Big Top Show. The holder of this ticket is guaranteed Safe Passage through the public areas only. Grimaldi reserves the right to rescind this safe passage guarantee to drunks and purveyors of violence. Guaranteed good time or your money back!

recap.text: Carl pounds a clown in a red wig and a little hat until its head caves in, then loots Clown Meat, a Big Top Ticket, 35 Gold, both butcher knives, the wig and the hat. Signet, banished from the tent, tells him to brandish a ticket. Carl walks in through a giant clown's mouth holding one out like a shield, and a round clown sniffs it like a dog sniffing a treat, hisses, and steps aside.

beats.headline: Off a dead clown
beats.text: A clown in a red wig and a little hat, carrying a pair of oversized butcher knives, goes down under Carl's fists, its forked tongue lolling, and he keeps pounding until its head caves in. A mass of red dots is fifteen seconds out. The clown's inventory reads Clown Meat, Big Top Ticket, 35 Gold. Carl loots it all, plus both knives, the wig and the hat. Mongo is still tearing at the clown's ankle, and when Carl picks him up he has gotten noticeably larger and squeals in rage.
beats.gist: A clown with butcher knives dies under Carl's fists, and he loots it of everything.

beats.headline: Brandish it and go in
beats.text: Signet cannot go inside the big top. She has been banished, her minions too, and the outside of the tent is impenetrable. Some of the clowns carry big top tickets, she says: find one and brandish it. The tickets are magical, and promise safe passage within the tent as long as the holder stays out of the three rings. The three poles that have to be broken are in the rings, and so is the vine. Carl already has two tickets. He reads one again and does not expect to have a good time.
beats.gist: Signet cannot enter the big top, so Carl holds two tickets that promise safe passage outside the rings.

beats.headline: Held out like a shield
beats.text: Carl walks into the big top through a giant clown's mouth with the ticket held out in front of him. Round the first corner stands a round clown, shorter than he is and almost three times as wide, who hisses at him. Carl brandishes the ticket like a shield. The clown leans in and sniffs it, like a treat held up to a dog, hisses again, and steps aside. Inside, nothing so much as glances at him. Carl keeps clutching the ticket anyway. If he drops it, he fears, he is toast.
beats.gist: Carl holds the ticket out like a shield, and a hissing clown sniffs it and steps aside.
